# Image v2

<!-- Generated by sdkgen; edit internal/cmd/sdkgen/service_docs.go. -->

Use Gophercloud v2.15.0's image/v2 API through one authenticated service object. Connection manages authentication, region, endpoint interface and TLS.

Service access: `conn.ImageV2(ctx)` (openstacksdk: `conn.image`).

Package docs describe the image workflows and the v2 service (`go doc ./image/` and `go doc ./image/v2/...`). Guides: [wait policies](../../docs/service-waits.md), [image task comparison](image-tasks-python.md), [direct upload](../upload-image.md), [image updates](../update.md), [image reads](../images.md), [image tasks](../image-tasks.md), [tasks](../tasks.md), [members](../members.md), [native members](members/README.md), [cache](../cache.md), [schemas](../schemas.md), [schema records](../schema-records.md), [locations](../locations.md), [tag/state changes](../mutations.md), [service information](serviceinfo/README.md), [usage](serviceinfo/usage.md), [deletion](../delete.md), [downloads](../download.md), [create/import](../create-import.md), [staging](imagedata/README.md), [task waiting/recreation](tasks/README.md), [import](imageimport/README.md), [identity finding](../../docs/finding-identities.md), [Native task calls](native-tasks.md).

## Go usage

```go
// Inside a function with context.Context ctx and *openstack.Connection conn.
service, err := conn.ImageV2(ctx)
if err != nil { return err }
for value, err := range service.Images.Resources.List(ctx) {
    if err != nil { return err }
    fmt.Println(value)
}
value, err := service.Images.Find(ctx, resource.Name("example"))
if err != nil { return err }
_ = value
```

Examples use `fmt` and `github.com/JSYoo5B/go-openstacksdk/resource`.
